Macht einen Container zu einer sortierbaren Liste – ein Entwurf, der sich während des Ziehens neu ordnet und beim Drop zurückgeschrieben wird.
Macht ein Element zu einem Drop-Ziel, mit Regeln dafür, was es annimmt, und Hooks für den Drop.
Registriert eine Zeile einer sortierbaren Liste oder eines Baums – sie lässt sich ziehen, macht Platz und landet in ihrem Slot.

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { DnDProvider } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import Segmented from './Segmented.vue';
import Tiles from './Tiles.vue';

const strategy = ref<'vertical' | 'horizontal' | 'grid'>('grid');
const placeholder = ref<'item' | 'indicator'>('item');
const behavior = ref<'sort' | 'swap'>('sort');
</script>

<template>
  <DnDProvider>
    <div class="demo">
      <div class="switches">
        <Segmented v-model="strategy" name="strategy" :options="['vertical', 'horizontal', 'grid']" />
        <Segmented v-model="placeholder" name="placeholder" :options="['item', 'indicator']" />
        <Segmented v-model="behavior" name="behavior" :options="['sort', 'swap']" />
      </div>
      <code class="call">makeSortableList(el, { strategy: '{{ strategy }}', placeholder: '{{ placeholder }}', behavior: '{{ behavior }}' })</code>
      <Tiles :strategy="strategy" :placeholder="placeholder" :behavior="behavior" />
    </div>
  </DnDProvider>
</template>

<style scoped>
.demo {
  display: flex;

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { makeSortableItem } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';

const props = defineProps<{ tile: { id: string; hue: number }; across: boolean }>();
const el = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('el');
// With `placeholder: 'indicator'`: the drop line while it is next to this tile, or, in a list
// that swaps, `side: 'swap'` on the tile the drop exchanges with.
const { indicator } = makeSortableItem(el, { item: () => props.tile });
</script>

<template>
  <li ref="el" class="tile" :class="[indicator && `drop-${indicator.side}`, { across }]" :style="{ '--hue': tile.hue }">
    <span class="swatch" />
    {{ tile.id }}
  </li>
</template>

<style scoped>
.tile {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: Canvas;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 10%, transparent);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: grab;
  user-select: none;
}

/* Across (rows and grids): squares. */
.tile.across {
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 72px;
  height: 72px;
  padding: 0;
}

.tile:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid #42b883;
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.tile[data-dnd-placeholder] {
  opacity: 0.35;
}

.swatch {
  width: 22px;
  height: 22px;
  border-radius: 7px;
  background: hsl(var(--hue) 70% 55%);
}

/* `behavior: 'swap'`: the tile the drop exchanges with. */
.tile.drop-swap {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #42b883;
}

/* The drop line: above or below in a column, left or right across. */
.tile.drop-before::before,
.tile.drop-after::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 3px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: #42b883;
}

.tile.drop-before::before {
  top: -6px;
}

.tile.drop-after::after {
  bottom: -6px;
}

.tile.across.drop-before::before,
.tile.across.drop-after::after {
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  width: 3px;
  height: auto;
}

.tile.across.drop-before::before {
  left: -7px;
  right: auto;
}

.tile.across.drop-after::after {
  left: auto;
  right: -7px;
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref, useTemplateRef } from 'vue';
import { makeSortableList } from '@vue-dnd-kit/core';
import Tile from './Tile.vue';

const props = defineProps<{
  strategy: 'vertical' | 'horizontal' | 'grid';
  placeholder: 'item' | 'indicator';
  behavior: 'sort' | 'swap';
}>();

const tiles = ref(['A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E', 'F', 'G', 'H'].map((id, i) => ({ id, hue: i * 45 })));
const listRef = useTemplateRef<HTMLElement>('list');

// Getters: the options are read live, so the switches change the list as it is.
const { items } = makeSortableList(listRef, {
  items: tiles,
  strategy: () => props.strategy,
  placeholder: () => props.placeholder,
  behavior: () => props.behavior,
});
</script>

<template>
  <ul ref="list" class="tiles" :class="strategy">
    <Tile v-for="tile in items" :key="tile.id" :tile="tile" :across="strategy !== 'vertical'" />
  </ul>
</template>

<style scoped>
.tiles {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 4px;
  list-style: none;
}

.tiles.vertical {

  flex-direction: column;

  width: 200px;
}

.tiles.horizontal {
  display: flex;
  gap: 10px;
  max-width: 100%;

}

.tiles.grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 72px);
  gap: 10px;
}
</style>
